Ever wonder how each engine arrived on the Island of Sodor? Hear those stories and more in this Steam Team pack, featuring audio cards for each of your favourite engines. From clever and helpful to serious and brave, each engine has something to offer and something to learn on the island of Sodor.Each card includes a collection of favourite episodes from the Thomas & Friends ™ Storytime Podcast, as well as a brand new interactive engine quiz! Can you count how many times you hear Thomas’ whistle? Tracks included: The Story of Thomas The Tank Engine Happy Birthday Thomas Banjo and the Bushfire Thomas the Hero Welcome to the Thomas Engine Quiz!  What colour is Thomas?  Blue!  What number is Thomas?  Number 1!  What are Thomas' coaches names?  Annie and Clarabel!  How many whistles can you count?  Thomas Quiz Answer 5 Which whistle is Thomas'?  The second whistle!  Who is Thomas' best friend? Thomas Quiz Answer 6 What does 'Thomas' start with?  'T' - The letter T!  What number comes after 1?  2!  What else is the colour blue?  Blueberries, bluebirds, the sky and more!  Can you name some other 'T' words?  Tap, tick, top and more!  Thanks for playing!
productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Ever wonder how each engine arrived on the Island of Sodor? Hear those stories and more in this Steam Team pack, featuring audio cards for each of your favourite engines. Learn all about Thomas, Percy, Nia, James, Emily, and Gordon! From clever and helpful to serious and brave, each engine has something to offer and something to learn on the island of Sodor.


Each card includes a collection of favourite episodes from the Thomas & Friends ™ Storytime Podcast, as well as a brand new interactive engine quiz! Can you count how many times you hear Thomas’ whistle? Toot toot!

#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
